item.text: I’ll inspect the booking policy code and tests first to see how blackout dates and admin overrides are currently modeled, then I’ll make the smallest compatible change and run the unittest suite.

The policy now distinguishes blackout ranges from the capacity gate. I’m adding focused regression tests for inclusive range boundaries, non-blackout dates, and the “admin still needs capacity” rule before running the full suite.
The regression coverage is in place. I’m running the benchmark’s required unittest command now.
